Months (thousands of dragons, half-yearly events and lots of gold)

The Dragon Slayer outfit is one of the most demanding in the game: you need to kill thousands of {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}, gather hundreds of scales and leathers, pay tens of millions of gold and obtain the rare {item:Bottled Dragon Breath} from the world boss of {wiki:Nimmersatt's Lair}. Everything is handed to {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} with the phrase {key:Dragon Slayer Attire}.
Legend has it that whoever manages to claim the {item:Bottled Dragon Breath|dragon's breath} will one day roam the land as a venerated Dragon Slayer.
Addon 2: base outfit + addon 1; 7500 Dragons and 7500 Dragon Lords in the Bestiary; title **Competent Beastslayer** (320,000 {wiki:Prey System|Hunting Task Points} accumulated and redeemed).
from the Nimmersatt's Lair world boss (base outfit)
Kill counts do not add up per stage: you need a **total** of 7500 Dragons and 7500 Dragon Lords in the Bestiary for everything.
Keep all dragon scales, leathers and trophies from now on: large quantities are needed.
The Nimmersatt's Lair event happens **every six months** on each world; it is the only way to get the Bottled Dragon Breath directly from the boss.

Take part in the {wiki:Nimmersatt's Lair} world event (introduced on 10 October 2023, it repeats every six months on each world). The world boss may drop the rare {item:Bottled Dragon Breath}, essential for the outfit. The lair is northwest of Carlin ({coord:32252,31590,7}): when the event is active, go to the coast **north** of Carlin and say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes} to {npc:Rascalio} to be taken to Nimmersatt's Lair. At the end, go back the same way to the entrance where Rascalio dropped you off.

Before going to the cyclops, make sure you have: 5000 Dragons and 5000 Dragon Lords in the {wiki:Bestiary}; the achievements **Hoard of the Dragon**, **Reason to Celebrate** and **Treasure Hunter**; 500 {item:Green Dragon Scale|Green Dragon Scales}, 100 {item:Green Dragon Leather}, 500 {item:Red Dragon Scale|Red Dragon Scales}, 100 {item:Red Dragon Leather}, the {item:Bottled Dragon Breath} and **75,000,000 gold**.

Go to **Ab'Dendriel** (by boat, say {key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes} to the captain in Thais, Carlin, Venore or Edron). {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} lives on the **4th floor of a tower** to the **northeast** of the depot: enter the small {creature:Rotworm|Rotworm} cave beneath the **wheat field east of the depot**, cross it to the tower and go up to the top floor (to leave, take the same path in reverse). Say {key:hi} and {key:Dragon Slayer Attire}. Pay the 75,000,000 gold and hand over the items.

You need: base outfit; 6250 Dragons and 6250 Dragon Lords in the Bestiary; 15 {item:Albino Dragon Leather}; 25 {item:Piece of Draconian Steel}; 10,000 {wiki:Tibiadrome|Drome Points}; **25,000,000 gold**.
Go back to {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} and say {key:Dragon Slayer Attire}. Pay and hand over the items.

You need: base outfit and addon 1; 7500 Dragons and 7500 Dragon Lords in the Bestiary; the title **Competent Beastslayer** (accumulate and redeem 320,000 {wiki:Prey System|Hunting Task Points}); 25 {item:Albino Dragon Leather}; 10 {item:Dragon Lord Trophy|Dragon Lord Trophies}; 10 {item:Dragon Trophy|Dragon Trophies}; **25,000,000 gold**.
Go back to {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} and say {key:Dragon Slayer Attire}. Pay and hand over the items.
The outfit obtained this way can only be used by the character who unlocked it.
The version of the outfit won in Tournaments remains account-wide (all characters of the person who won it).
